Four held at preparation for nonlinear orbital parameters (SINI for J1909 and J1614, FB2 for J2241, PB/OMDOT degeneracy for J1811).

Holds are not non-detections. Linearity neighbourhood uses the larger of released and search-covariance uncertainties (released MPTA uncertainties are about 3 times smaller). run01 destinations consumed. 26 approved targets not yet prepared.
